channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Fox 9’s Courtney Godfrey will co-host Paralympic Winter Games
item.description: Minnesota’s Mallory Weggemann also will be a key member of NBCUniversal’s coverage.

item.title: What a hoot! Flaco the Eurasian eagle owl to be inducted into World Owl Hall of Fame
item.description: The late New York City owl will be honored during the International Owl Festival in Houston, Minn.

item.title: Final results from boys hockey Class 1A quarterfinals at Grand Casino Arena
item.description: Mahtomedi, Hibbing/Chisholm, Delano and Warroad were winners and advance to Friday’s semifinals.

item.title: Lou Holtz, college football staple who coached Notre Dame to 1988 national title, dies at 89
item.description: a one-of-a-kind iconoclast in a profession brimming with originals.

item.title: Close to 650 federal agents remain in Minnesota weeks after border czar announced end of operation
item.description: There are still more than quadruple the 150 agents Tom Homan said there would be in the state by the end of last week.

item.title: Minnesota DHS worker spared prosecution, but receives 1-day suspension for keying Teslas
item.description: The state Department of Human Services employee went around his downtown neighborhood and inflicted $20,000 in damage to six vehicles made by Elon Musk’s company.

item.title: St. Paul approves new drive-thru regulations
item.description: After the “Carbucks” headache and years of study, St. Paul will allow new drive-thrus, but with new restrictions.

item.title: Walz and Ellison clash with Republicans in fraud hearing, condemn Trump immigration crackdown
item.description: The hearing came as Operation Metro Surge winds down in Minnesota and as the state continues to grapple with fraud in its social services programs.

item.title: Vikings plan to release DT Jonathan Allen in cost-cutting move
item.description: The Vikings are unwinding moves they made before last season as they try to clear more $40 million to get under the NFL salary cap.

item.title: Minneapolis council members press chief on why police didn’t do more during ICE surge
item.description: Police Chief Brian O’Hara said police officers can’t stop federal agents from enforcing federal law unless they witness something egregious.
